verdict.rationale: Evidence shows Adyen offers payment links (adyen-docs-24) and an MCP server for LLM-driven interactions (adyen-docs-5, adyen-probe-4), but there is no evidence of a 'product' or 'price' catalog object API akin to billing/invoicing primitives that an agent could provision alongside a payment link in one session. Missing for 10: documented product/price object creation endpoints, evidence of agentic single-session workflow combining product+price+payment link, and any hands-on confirmation of this flow.
